clarity.note: Both connected routes physically traversed at both tiers. Separate low screenshot-only controller after logged east-junction prefix reaches(-35.419,47.813), t5136, via16manual WASD commands. Plaza shortcut hits collision and recovers down-left onto marked road, then upper-left along lake road; fences/facades and wall read as limits, no dead-end street looked like the route and no wall/slab crossed. One precautionary sidestep reason incorrectly described a stalled frame; the next action explicitly corrects it from HUD101→88m. The same reviewer previously read the authored map, so this is image-driven navigation, not a blinded first-exposure usability trial. Native driver detached throughout; no post-prefix nav/planner calls. Close zoom limits distant route visibility, wide zoom makes continuity legible. Courier god only; incoming companions can die naturally, no survivor-pace claim.
